ModMetaData.name: Better Work Tab
ModMetaData.author: Coolnether123
ModMetaData.description: Better Work Tab v2.0 beta overhauls RimWorld's Work tab with drag-and-drop, skill overlays, automation rules, sub-work jobs, time priority schedules, extended priorities, and visual customization. All features are toggleable in settings with extensive customization options. Features - Drag and drop work column and pawn row reordering - Extended max priorities from vanilla 4 up to 99 - Sub-work job drilldown with global and pawn-specific priorities - Time-of-day priority schedules for work and sub-work jobs - Skill level overlay (hold SHIFT) - Auto-assignment rulesets - Workload presets - Visual dividers - Force pawns to work on unassigned tasks - Advanced pawn and column highlighting - Angled or vanilla-style column headers - Colonist and bed counts - Right-click pawn quick actions - Multiplayer support for supported versions with Zetrith Multiplayer - Detailed settings for UI, priorities, rules, workloads, and layout Compatibility - Compatible with most work-type mods - [FSF] Complex Jobs column ordering is supported - Vanilla Skills Expanded passion types are supported in rule conditions when the mod is active - Do Once - Noncommittal Work is compatible; BWT suppresses its duplicate borrowed menu patches and uses BWT's sub-work-aware version - Useful Marks markers appear on pawn icons when available - Grouped Pawns List is overridden inside this Work tab - CompactWorkTab overlaps this UI and should not be used together - Fluffy WorkTab and forks are hard conflicts Version Support - 1.6 -> v2.0 beta - 1.5 -> v2.0 beta - 1.4 -> v2.0 beta - 1.3 -> v2.0 beta - 1.2 -> v2.0 beta - Multiplayer does not work - 1.1 -> v2.0 beta - Multiplayer does not work - 1.0 -> v2.0 beta - Multiplayer does not work - 0.19 -> v2.0 beta - Multiplayer does not work - 0.18 -> v2.0 beta - Multiplayer does not work - 0.17 -> v2.0 beta - Multiplayer does not work - 0.16 -> v2.0 beta - Multiplayer does not work - 0.15 -> v2.0 beta - Multiplayer does not work - 0.14 -> v2.0 beta - Multiplayer does not work - 0.13 -> v2.0 beta - Multiplayer does not work - Alpha 4 / 0.4 -> v2.0 beta - Multiplayer does not work Support Questions, bug reports, or suggestions?
